en-GB.author: Ahmed Nefzaoui
en-GB.description: Free, open-source download manager for Windows with multi-connection acceleration, crash-safe resume, torrents, video downloads and browser integration.
en-GB.longDescription:
Free, open-source download manager for Windows, written from scratch in Rust. It keeps the toolbar, categories, download list, progress window and browser button where you expect them, and downloads a file over every connection at once.

Downloading
- Acceleration and resume: a file split over up to 32 connections, re-split until the last byte, and resumed after any crash.
- Browser extension: downloads you click in Chrome, Edge, Brave, Opera, Vivaldi or Firefox go straight to MDM, sign-in included.
- Video downloads: videos from YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok and well over a thousand other sites, in the quality you choose.
- Image galleries: paste a gallery's address and MDM saves all its pictures into a folder of their own.
- Torrents: magnet links and .torrent files beside your other downloads, queued and scheduled like any of them.
- Debrid accounts: file-host links unlocked through Real-Debrid, AllDebrid or Premiumize, then downloaded with MDM's speed and resume.
- Link grabber: a page's links gathered, sorted into packages and checked online, then the archives unpacked when they arrive.
- Batch downloads: one address with an asterisk fetches a numbered series; a text file of links adds them all.
- RSS feeds: follow torrent feeds, and let rules add the new episodes you want, each one only once.

Organising
- Scheduler and queues: queues started and stopped by the clock, a few files at a time, the computer off at the end.
- Speed limiter: one cap for all of MDM, a limit per file, and full speed when you're away.
- Categories: downloads sorted by type into folders of their own, with Finished and Unfinished one click away.
- Archives extracted: ZIP, TAR and more extracted as they arrive, 7z and RAR with 7-Zip, split archives once complete.
- Verify checksum: paste the checksum a site publishes, and MDM says plainly whether your file matches it.
- Moving from IDM: your IDM list comes over in one file, each download with its address, referrer and cookies.

Network
- Network adapter: every connection MDM opens goes out through the adapter you pick, and stops when it disconnects.
- DNS and proxies: the system's proxy, your own, a SOCKS proxy or your network's auto-config script.
- Remote control: paste a link on your phone and the computer downloads it. Watch and pause from anywhere at home.
- Server mode: MDM without a window on a NAS, in Docker or on Unraid, fed from your phone or browser.

The app
- Notification area: starts with the computer in the notification area, and hides progress windows there while they run.
- Themes: nine looks, light and dark, from Classic to Aqua, or your own in a text file.
- Crash reports: a crash or freeze opens a report you read first, then send on GitHub yourself if you want.
- 86 languages: every display language Windows 11 offers, picked by flag, with Arabic, Hebrew and Persian right to left.
- Accessibility: Narrator and NVDA are supported, and everything can be done from the keyboard, menus and dialogs.
- Command line: IDM's command-line switches, a terminal downloader with JSON output, and a local API for other programs.
- AI assistants: Claude, Cursor, VS Code and other MCP assistants can list, add, pause and resume your downloads.
en-GB.name: Mister Download Manager

zh-CN.description: 适用于 Windows 的免费开源下载管理器，支持多连接加速、崩溃后安全续传、种子下载、网页视频下载和浏览器集成。
zh-CN.longDescription:
适用于 Windows 的免费开源下载管理器，使用 Rust 从零编写。工具栏、分类、下载列表、进度窗口和浏览器按钮都在您熟悉的位置，并可同时使用所有连接下载一个文件。

下载
- 加速与续传：文件可拆分为最多 32 个连接，重新拆分直到最后一个字节，并在任何崩溃后恢复下载。
- 浏览器扩展：在 Chrome、Edge、Brave、Opera、Vivaldi 或 Firefox 中点击的下载会直接发送到 MDM，包括登录信息。
- 视频下载：可从 YouTube、Vimeo、TikTok 以及上千个其他网站下载视频，并选择您想要的画质。
- 图片画廊：粘贴画廊地址，MDM 会将所有图片保存到单独的文件夹中。
- 种子：磁力链接和 .torrent 文件可与其他下载任务一起，像普通任务一样排队和计划。
- 网盘账户：通过 Real-Debrid、AllDebrid 或 Premiumize 解锁文件托管链接，然后用 MDM 的高速和续传功能下载。
- 链接抓取器：抓取页面链接，将其分类打包并在线检查，下载完成后自动解压压缩包。
- 批量下载：一个带星号的地址可抓取一系列编号文件；一个包含链接的文本文件可添加所有链接。
- RSS 源：关注种子 RSS 源，设置规则自动添加您想要的新剧集，每集只添加一次。

整理
- 计划程序和队列：按时启动和停止队列，每次下载少量文件，完成后自动关闭电脑。
- 速度限制器：为 MDM 设置一个总限速，或为每个文件设置限速，当您离开时可全速下载。
- 类别：下载文件按类型分类到各自的文件夹中，一键查看“已完成”和“未完成”任务。
- 自动解压压缩包：ZIP、TAR 等格式的压缩包在下载完成后自动解压；7z 和 RAR 格式通过 7-Zip 解压；分卷压缩包在全部下载完成后解压。
- 验证校验和：粘贴网站发布的校验和，MDM 会清楚地告知您的文件是否匹配。
- 从 IDM 迁移：您的 IDM 列表可导入为一个文件，每个下载任务都包含其地址、引用页和 Cookie。

网络
- 网络适配器：MDM 的所有连接都通过您选择的适配器进行，并在适配器断开连接时停止。
- DNS 和代理：可使用系统代理、您自己的代理、SOCKS 代理或您网络的自动配置脚本。
- 远程控制：在手机上粘贴链接，电脑即可下载。在家中任何地方查看和暂停下载。
- 服务器模式：在 NAS、Docker 或 Unraid 上运行无界面的 MDM，通过手机或浏览器进行管理。

应用
- 通知区域：随电脑启动并在通知区域运行，运行时将进度窗口隐藏在通知区域。
- 主题：九种外观，包括浅色和深色模式，从“经典”到“Aqua”，或在文本文件中自定义。
- 崩溃报告：崩溃或冻结时会打开一份报告，您可以先阅读，如果需要，再自行发送到 GitHub。
- 86 种语言：支持 Windows 11 提供的所有显示语言，通过旗帜选择，包括阿拉伯语、希伯来语和波斯语的从右到左显示。
- 辅助功能：支持讲述人 (Narrator) 和 NVDA，所有操作均可通过键盘、菜单和对话框完成。
- 命令行：IDM 的命令行开关、带 JSON 输出的终端下载器，以及供其他程序使用的本地 API。
- AI 助手：Claude、Cursor、VS Code 及其他 MCP 助手可以列出、添加、暂停和恢复您的下载。
